brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base with nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build has exactly one piece: piece:0,0,0;half-n at 0,0,0. No other piece cells beside (q±1,r) or on top (level 1) are placed. get_build counts piece:1.

requirements.requirement: Five drawers in that single base
requirements.evidence: Configurator offers at most 1 drawer socket on a single isolated base. Tested variants: full (0 sockets), half-n (1 socket s), half-s (1 socket n), quarter-nw (0 sockets). No storeys/variant increases it. With half-n only 1 drawer can be placed (drawer:0#0,0#cut). Five drawers requires additional adjacent bases to host notch/bay trays, which would violate the 'nothing else added beside or on top' constraint.

finish.summary: Single isolated base is possible, but five drawers in that single base is not allowed by configurator rules. An isolated full hex base offers 0 drawer sockets; an isolated half base offers exactly 1 (half-n -> s, half-s -> n). Tested via find_sockets for drawer on each base variant - max 1. Build left as single half-n base to demonstrate minimal constraint-compliant state; check_build is clear (meshClash clear, only OPEN_CAP_FACE info).
